name: Colonial Coal International Corp.
summary: Colonial Coal International Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of coal properties in Canada. The company owns a 100% interest in the Huguenot Property consists of seventeen coal licenses covering an area of approximately 9,531 hectares located in the Liard Mining Division, northeastern British Columbia; and the Flatbed Property comprising eight coal licenses covering approximately an area of 9,607 hectares located in the Liard Mining Division, northeastern British Columbia. Colonial Coal International Corp. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
